title: 10 Things a Godly Man Builds Into His First Apartment
caption:
Your first apartment is the first place nobody's watching. No parents, no roommates, no one to notice what time you go to bed or what's open on the laptop.

That's exactly why it matters. Build it so the man inside those walls is the same man people see on Sunday: the open Bible, the clean browser, the table with extra chairs, the key a brother can use.

Send this to the brother who just signed his first lease.
